Careers

Do work you'll be proud to put your name to

We are always glad to hear from talented lawyers, trainees and business services professionals.

How to apply

Why Trueworth

A place to do your best work, and to grow

  • 01

    A named mentor

    Every junior lawyer has a named mentor from their first day.

  • 02

    Credit where it is due

    When we report work to a client, we name the people who did it.

  • 03

    Feedback within a week

    Everyone who worked on a major matter gets written feedback within a week of it closing.

  • 04

    Training every year

    Every lawyer has protected time for training, every year.

  • 05

    Pro bono

    Every lawyer gives time to pro bono work.

  • 06

    Holidays are taken

    Everyone takes their full holiday entitlement. The founders set the example.

Who we hire

Three ways to join us

  • Trainees

    For those starting out in law. You work on real matters from the start, with a mentor beside you.

  • Lawyers

    For qualified lawyers who want responsibility and straight feedback. Titles here are earned on published criteria.

  • Business services

    For the people who keep the firm running well: operations, finance, marketing and client service.

How titles are earned at Trueworth

How to apply

Send us a short note and your CV

We do not always advertise roles, so we welcome speculative applications.

  1. Write to us

    Email your CV and a short note on what interests you to careers@trueworth.example.

  2. A first conversation

    If there is a fit, we arrange an informal call to get to know each other.

  3. Meet the team

    You meet the people you would work with, and ask them anything.

  4. A clear answer

    We tell you the outcome promptly, whatever it is.

Email careers@trueworth.example
